method.zhHans: 要知道那种事轻而易举：只要装几台摄像机——在树篱底下，柯南发现了三脚架的痕迹；他早上去了庭园美术馆，在池边架了一台摄像机。他当时操控了抽签，让 Ushikubo 抽到容易下手的地点，而给自己最远、最容易制造不在场证明的地方。
method.en: He can know something like that easily by setting up some video cameras, that was under the hedge, Conan found some tripod marks, he had gone to Teien Art Museum in the morning, and set up a video camera by the pond. He manipulated the lots at that time for Ushikubo to pick an easy place to be murdered and gave himself the furthest location where you could create your alibi easily.

evidence.zhHans: 证据是 Ryosuke 说过的一句话：「我喜欢有情感的句子，比如父亲对女儿的爱。」要知道那种事轻而易举：只要装几台摄像机——在树篱底下，柯南发现了三脚架的痕迹；他早上去了庭园美术馆，在池边架了一台摄像机。之后，你把八木泽的眼药放在 Ushikubo 的手指旁，再把雨衣和凶器扔到月照寺，取回庭园美术馆的录像，若无其事地回到旅馆。证据是 Ushikubo 的临终留言——那既不是指向竹子，也不是指向武士宅邸。
evidence.en: The proof is Ryosuke said, "I like verses with emotions, like the love of a father for his daughter". He can know something like that easily by setting up some video cameras, that was under the hedge, Conan found some tripod marks, he had gone to Teien Art Museum in the morning, and set up a video camera by the pond. After that, you placed Yagisawa's eye medication near Ushikubo's finger, then threw the raincoat and the murder weapon at Gesshoji, retrieved the video from Teien Art Museum and nonchalantly you returned to the hotel. The proof is Ushikubo's dying message, that wasn't pointing to the bamboo nor to the samurai's mansion.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Ryosuke Shiina。首先，他在你们吟诵的句子里埋了暗号：第七句的第七个字、第九句的第九个字、第十一句的第十一个字，连起来读是「我就是犯人」。接着，他一边吟诵挑衅的句子，一边在潜意识里认罪说那就是 Ryosuke Shiina 所为。把自己的讯息嵌进你的句子里，把 小五郎 和警方都嘲弄了一番，暗自窃笑。小五郎从他的这种性格判断：只要条件合适，他一定会把从 Ushikubo 那里偷来的句子当作自己的作品吟出来——理由很简单，因为他真的很喜欢那句。证据是 Ryosuke 说过的一句话：「我喜欢有情感的句子，比如父亲对女儿的爱。」而所需的条件是：先把八木泽当作嫌疑人拘押，再让上一句末尾的「花」以接龙方式与第十三句相连。正如小五郎借柯南之口预测的那样，他把从 Ushikubo 那里偷来的句子吟了出来，仿佛亲自展示自己的胜利。要知道那种事轻而易举：只要装几台摄像机——在树篱底下，柯南发现了三脚架的痕迹；他早上去了庭园美术馆，在池边架了一台摄像机。他用偷来的 Ushikubo 备用手机给八木泽发了一条短信，于是八木泽去了松江城并杀死了 Ushikubo。之后，他把八木泽的眼药放在 Ushikubo 的手指旁，再把雨衣和凶器扔到月照寺，取回庭园美术馆的录像，若无其事地回到旅馆。证据是 Ushikubo 的临终留言——那既不是指向竹子，也不是指向武士宅邸。那个留言是数字「1」，指的是连歌的第一句「发句」。随后，椿刑警被问到，他观察的结果是 Ryosuke 的鞋：左脚、最上方的鞋钩上，确认留有 Ushikubo 伸出的、带血食指的指纹。换句话说，他的临终留言指的就是你鞋上的鞋钩。他的心大概已被 Ushikubo 笔记本里的句子夺走，没注意到对方碰到了你鞋上的鞋钩。小五郎最初怀疑 Ryosuke 的最后一个依据，是前一晚抽签时的情形：通常制作签的人最后才抽，但他第二个就抽了，还说「接下来按年龄排，轮到我了」。他当时操控了抽签，让 Ushikubo 抽到容易下手的地点，而给自己最远、最容易制造不在场证明的地方。Ryosuke 供认，并揭示 Ushikubo 一直在骗他们的钱，他无法原谅他。
resolution.en: The culprit is Ryosuke Shiina. First, he added codes in the verses that you recited, the seventh word from the seventh verse, ninth word from the ninth verse and the eleventh word from the eleventh verse. It says "I am the culprit". And then, you recited provoking verses while subconsciously confessing that it was Ryosuke Shiina. Adding his message in your verses, ridiculing both Kogoro and the police, chuckling away. Judging from that part of your personality, Kogoro thought that with the appropriate conditions, you would definitely recite the verse stolen from Ushikubo, as his own. With the simple reason that you really like this verse. The proof is Ryosuke said, "I like verses with emotions, like the love of a father for his daughter". And the required conditions were, having Yagisawa taken into custody as the suspect, and connecting the thirteenth verse on flowers from the verse prior to it in shiritori manner. Just as Kogoro via Conan had predicted, you read the verse you stole from Ushikubo, as if to personally display your victory. He can know something like that easily by setting up some video cameras, that was under the hedge, Conan found some tripod marks, he had gone to Teien Art Museum in the morning, and set up a video camera by the pond. With, Ushikubo's spare cellphone that he had stolen, you sent a text message to Yagisawa, then he went to Matsue Castle and murdered Ushikubo. After that, you placed Yagisawa's eye medication near Ushikubo's finger, then threw the raincoat and the murder weapon at Gesshoji, retrieved the video from Teien Art Museum and nonchalantly you returned to the hotel. The proof is Ushikubo's dying message, that wasn't pointing to the bamboo nor to the samurai's mansion. The message was the number, '1'. That means the first verse of linked verse called Hokku. Then, asked Detective Tsubaki, the result of his observation is the shoes of Ryosuke, on the left foot, topmost left hook, they confirmed Ushikubo's stretched bloody index finger fingerprints. In other words, his dying message was the hook on your shoe. His heart was probably taken in by the verse in Ushikubo's notebook and didn't notice him touching the hook on your shoe. The final evidence why Kogoro suspect Ryosuke was his first suspicion were when he was drawing a lots last night. Normally, the one who created the lots would draw last. But, he went on the second draw, he said "Next, according to age line up, will be my turn". He manipulated the lots at that time for Ushikubo to pick an easy place to be murdered and gave himself the furthest location where you could create your alibi easily. Ryosuke confesses and reveals Ushikubo is tricking them out of their money, he couldn't forgive him.
